title: State of H.P. v. Lekh Raj

content.caseIdentity: State of H.P. v. Lekh Raj, (2000) 1 SCC 247
content.holding: The Supreme Court affirmed that where the accused is apprehended in prompt possession of stolen property identifiable by unique characteristics, the absence of a formal Test Identification Parade does not weaken the prosecution case.
